mail.agencyInvite.l1: {inviter} invites you to join the agency “{agency}” on hwe.

mail.amendmentCreated.l1: Your landlord proposes an amendment to your lease (rent, charges or term).
mail.amendmentCreated.l2: It only applies once you have signed it:
mail.amendmentCreated.subject: lease amendment to sign for “{title}”
mail.amendmentSigned.l1: Your tenant signed the amendment: it applies to the lease from its effective date.
mail.amendmentSigned.subject: amendment signed (“{title}”)
mail.candidateProposed.l2: Approve or decline this applicant from your space:

mail.chargeRegularization.balance.even: Advance payments and actual charges match — nothing to pay.

mail.mandateProposed.anyProperty: one or more of your properties

mail.mandateProposed.subject: {agency} proposes a mandate to you
mail.messageReceived.subject: new message from {sender}
mail.noticeGiven.l1: {tenant} has given notice. The lease ends on {date}.
mail.noticeGiven.l2: Remember to schedule the move-out inspection and the return of the deposit.
mail.noticeGiven.subject: notice received for “{title}”
mail.ownerInvite.l1: {agency} manages {properties} on hwe and has created your landlord space.
mail.ownerInvite.l2: Choose your password to follow your property (requests, lease, rents, fees) and approve key decisions:
mail.ownerInvite.l3: You can also use “forgot password” with this address.
mail.ownerInvite.subject: {agency} manages your property: activate your space
mail.ownerNoticeGiven.l1: Your landlord is giving you notice to vacate for {reason}.
mail.ownerNoticeGiven.l3: Details are in your space, under My rental.
mail.ownerNoticeGiven.reason.REPOSSESSIO: the landlord taking the home back
mail.ownerNoticeGiven.subject: notice to vacate from your landlord (“{title}”)
mail.passwordReset.l1: You asked to reset your password. Open this link (valid for 30 minutes, single use) to choose a new password:
mail.passwordReset.l2: If you did not make this request, ignore this email — your password stays unchanged.
mail.passwordReset.subject: reset your password
mail.rentDeclared.l1: {tenant} reports having paid {amount} for the {period} rent.
mail.rentDeclared.l2: Check that the money has reached YOUR ACCOUNT (operator statement), not just the attached screenshot: a screenshot can be faked, a statement cannot.
mail.rentDeclared.l3: Approve or reject it from your landlord space, under Rents.
mail.rentDeclared.subject: rent payment to verify ({period})
mail.rentRejected.l1: Your landlord could not confirm receiving your payment for {period}.
mail.rentRejected.l2: Check the amount, the number used and the transaction ID, then report the payment again from My rents.
mail.rentRejected.l3: If you are sure you paid, contact your landlord through the messaging.
mail.rentRejected.subject: your rent payment was not approved ({period})

mail.rentReminder.l2: Your landlord's payment details and the payment report form are in your space, under My rents.
mail.rentValidated.l1: Your payment of {amount} for {period} has been confirmed by your landlord.
mail.rentValidated.l2: Your receipt no. {receipt} is available in your tenant space, under My rents.
mail.rentValidated.subject: rent receipt {period}
mail.sub.adminReactivated.body: Your agency has been reactivated by the hwe administrator.
mail.sub.adminReactivated.subject: account reactivated
mail.sub.adminSuspended.body: Your agency has been suspended by the hwe administrator: the account is read-only. Contact support.
mail.sub.adminSuspended.subject: account suspended by the administrator
mail.sub.approved.body: Your payment for the {plan} plan ({months} months) has been approved. Subscription active until {end}. Invoice {number} can be downloaded from the Subscription page.
mail.sub.approved.subject: payment approved ({number})
mail.sub.free.body: Without payment, “{agency}” now runs on the free plan (limited number of agents and mandates). Properties beyond the limit remain viewable but can no longer be edited.
mail.sub.free.subject: {agency} moves to the free plan
mail.sub.grace.body: The current period of “{agency}” ended on {end}. Pay your subscription before {graceEnd} to keep every feature.
mail.sub.grace.subject: {agency} subscription: grace period
mail.sub.recorded.body: A payment for the {plan} plan ({months} months) has been recorded. Subscription active until {end}.
mail.sub.recorded.subject: payment recorded ({number})
mail.sub.rejected.subject: payment report rejected
mail.sub.reminderDays.body: The current period (trial or subscription) of “{agency}” ends on {end}. Pay your subscription to keep going without limits.
mail.sub.reminderDays.subject: {agency} subscription: ends in {n} day
mail.sub.suspended.body: The subscription of “{agency}” is suspended: your team can view properties, history and statements, but can no longer act. Pay your subscription to reactivate the account.
mail.sub.suspended.subject: {agency}: read-only account
mail.ticketOpened.subject: incident reported on “{title}”

mail.ticketResolved.subject: incident resolved: “{ticket}”
mail.visitAnswered.l1.confirmed: Your viewing of “{title}” is confirmed on {date} at {time}.
mail.visitAnswered.l1.declined: The landlord did not accept this time slot for “{title}”.

mail.visitRequested.subject: viewing request for “{title}”

pdf.invoice.title: Invoice {number}

pdf.receipt.confirmed: Payment reported by the tenant, then confirmed by the landlord on the hwe platform.
pdf.receipt.title: Rent receipt
pdf.statement.footer: Statement based on the rents approved and the fees calculated on the hwe platform, according to the mandate terms. hwe does not hold any funds: payments are made outside the platform.
pdf.statement.noRents: No rent approved for the period.
pdf.statement.title: Management statement — {month}
